meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大任务拆成可核查的步骤,一段段稳着推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务很长,需要拆成步骤、随时停下再接着做
copy.tagline_en: Break big work into checkable steps and push through them steadily
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your task is long and needs stepwise, pausable execution

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会把工作拆成一条条超细步骤，用 ulw-loop CLI 把目标和进度记在 .omo/ulw-loop 下，每个成功标准都要有真实可观察的证据；中途上下文丢失也会先重读目标再续跑。
howto.when: 当你要求目标循环、可长期运行且带检查点的执行时接管；提到 “ulw-loop”、“ulw” 等关键词，或要人工 QA、证据导向的工作时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这批代码改动拆成可验证的步骤并逐个记录证据
say.note: 会先注册目标，再逐步执行留证

say.text: 查一下当前 ulw-loop 的进度和目标状态
say.note: 读取 .omo/ulw-loop 里的会话状态

say.text: 恢复上次的 ulw-loop 会话，按已有目标继续跑
say.note: 重读目标与台账后接着执行

howto.what_en: Claude breaks work into ultra-granular steps, registers goals and progress in the ulw-loop CLI under .omo/ulw-loop, and binds each success criterion to observable evidence; after context loss it re-reads goals and resumes.
howto.when_en: Runs when you want a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution; also triggers on mentions of “ulw-loop”, “ulw”, or manual QA and evidence-led work.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to split these edits into verifiable steps and log evidence.
say_en.note: It registers goals first, then runs step by step.

say_en.text: Check the current ulw-loop progress and goal status.
Resume the last ulw-loop session and continue from its goals.
say_en.note: Re-reads goals and ledger, then resumes.
